evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: The medial meniscus shows an inferiorly surfacing oblique tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: There is mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis with slight thinning of articular cartilage
evidence.PF OA: Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the patellofemoral compartment.
evidence.Contusion: No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.
evidence.Fracture: No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.
